scope: Independent runtime ARM64 blocks; no Linux/Android/iPhone integration
measurement: Three warm rounds per backend in separate processes; GCD reverses backend order. Same ARM64 bytes, 16 KiB pages and checked complete data arrays; warmup touches every private data page. Timed execution stays in context 0 and includes one-million-instruction slice entries; initialization, table setup, context-switch checks and result verification are excluded. No Linux scheduling, page updates, fallback or device measurement.
statistics_scope: Direct counters are cumulative, including correctness checks and warmup. Optional footprint phases include initialization, warmup and native result verification; their arithmetic sample mean, sampled peak and latest cover different work from wall/thread CPU execution timing.
